description: An electric streetcar with a trolley pole raised to an overhead wire, varnished wood body with a glowing headlamp, rolls down a cobbled brick street. Crowds of men in bowler and top hats and women in long dresses and straw hats line both sides and watch; a few are gesturing. Horse-drawn carriages and brick and frame buildings recede in the background, with smoke or mist drifting through the scene. A small illegible scrawl, likely the painter's signature, sits in the lower right corner. The painting fills the whole image edge to edge with no frame.
